translations.translation: allAha ke nAma se jo bar3A kRpAlu aura atyanta dayAvAna haiM|
prazaMsA allAha hI ke lie haiM jo sAre saMsAra kA raba haiM
bar3A kRpAlu, atyanta dayAvAna haiM
badalA die jAne ke dina kA mAlika haiM
hama terI bandagI karate haiM aura tujhI se madada mA~gate haiM
hameM sIdhe mArga para calA
una logoM ke mArga para jo tere kRpApAtra hue, jo na prakopa ke bhAgI hue aura na pathabhraSTa
alIfa॰ lAma॰ mIma॰
vaha kitAba yahI haiM, jisameM koI sandeha nahIM, mArgadarzana haiM Dara rakhanevAloM ke lie,
jo anadekhe ImAna lAte haiM, namAz2a qAyama karate haiM aura jo kucha hamane unheM diyA haiM usameM se kucha kharca karate haiM;
aura jo usa para ImAna lAte haiM jo tuma para utarA aura jo tumase pahale avatarita huA haiM aura Aqhirata para vahI loga vizvAsa rakhate haiM;
vahI loga haiM jo apane raba ke sIdhe mArga para haiM aura vahI saphalatA prApta karanevAle haiM
jina logoM ne kufra (inakAra) kiyA unake lie barAbara haiM, cAhe tumane unheM saceta kiyA ho yA saceta na kiyA ho, ve ImAna nahIM lAe~ge
allAha ne unake diloM para aura kAnoM para muhara lagA dI hai aura unakI A~khoM para paradA par3A hai, aura unake lie bar3I yAtanA hai
kucha loga aise haiM jo kahate haiM ki hama allAha aura antima dina para ImAna rakhate haiM, hAlA~ki ve ImAna nahIM rakhate
ve allAha aura ImAnavAloM ke sAtha dhokhebAz2I kara rahe haiM, hAlA~ki dhokhA ve svayaM apane-Apako hI de rahe haiM, parantu ve isako mahasUsa nahIM karate
unake diloM meM roga thA to allAha ne unake roga ko aura bar3hA diyA aura unake lie jhUTha bolate rahane ke kAraNa unake lie eka dukhada yAtanA hai
aura jaba unase kahA jAtA hai ki 'z2amIna meM bigAr3a paidA na karo', to kahate haiM, 'hama to kevala sudhAraka hai|''
jAna lo! vahI haiM jo bigAr3a paidA karate haiM, parantu unheM ehasAsa nahIM hotA
aura jaba unase kahA jAtA hai, 'ImAna lAo jaise loga ImAna lAe haiM', kahate haiM, 'kyA hama ImAna lAe jaise kama samajha loga ImAna lAe haiM?' jAna lo, vahI kama samajha haiM parantu jAnate nahIM

aura jaba ImAna lAnevAloM se milate haiM to kahate, 'hama bhI ImAna lAe haiM,' aura jaba ekAnta meM apane zaitAnoM ke pAsa pahu~cate haiM, to kahate haiM, 'hama to tumhAre sAtha haiM aura yaha to hama kevala parihAsa kara rahe haiM|'
allAha unake sAtha parihAsa kara rahA hai aura unheM unakI sarakazI meM DhIla die jAtA hai, ve bhaTakate phira rahe haiM
yahI ve loga haiM, jinhoMne mArgadarzana ke badale meM gumarAhI mola lI, kintu unake isa vyApAra meM na koI lAbha pahu~cAyA, aura na hI ve sIdhA mArga pA sake

unakI misAla aisI haiM jaise kisI vyakti ne Aga jalAI, phira jaba usane usake vAtAvaraNa ko prakAzita kara diyA, to allAha ne usakA prakAza hI chIna liyA aura unheM a~dheroM meM chor3a diyA jisase unheM kucha sujhAI nahIM de rahA haiM
ve bahare haiM, gU~geM haiM, andhe haiM, aba ve lauTane ke nahIM

yA (unakI misAla aisI hai) jaise AkAza se varSA ho rahI ho jisake sAtha a~dhere hoM aura garaja aura camaka bhI ho, ve bijalI kI kar3aka ke kAraNa mRtyu ke bhaya se apane kAnoM meM u~galiyA~ de le rahe hoM - aura allAha ne to inakAra karanevAloM ko ghera rakhA haiM

mAno zIghra hI bijalI unakI A~khoM kI rauzanI ucaka lene ko hai; jaba bhI unapara camakatI ho, ve cala par3ate ho aura jaba unapara a~dherA chA jAtA haiM to khar3e ho jAte ho; agara allAha cAhatA to unakI sunane aura dekhane kI zakti bilakula hI chIna letA| nissandeha allAha ko hara cIz2a kI sAmarthya prApta hai
ai logo! bandagI karo apane raba kI jisane tumheM aura tumase pahale ke logoM ko paidA kiyA, tAki tuma baca sako;

vahI hai jisane tumhAre lie z2amIna ko pharza aura AkAza ko chata banAyA, aura AkAza se pAnI utArA, phira usake dvArA hara prakAra kI paidAvAra kI aura phala tumhArI rojI ke lie paidA kie, ataH jaba tuma jAnate ho to allAha ke samakakSa na ThaharAo

aura agara usake viSaya meM jo hamane apane bande para utArA haiM, tuma kisI sandeha meM na ho to usa jaisI koI sUrA le Ao aura allAha se haTakara apane sahAyakoM ko bulA lo jinake A maujUda hone para tumheM vizvAsa haiM, yadi tuma sacce ho
phira agara tuma aisA na kara sako aura tuma kadApi nahIM kara sakate, to Daro usa Aga se jisakA Idhana inasAna aura patthara haiM, jo inakAra karanevAloM ke lie taiyAra kI gaI hai

jo loga ImAna lAe aura unhoMne acche karma kie unheM zubha sUcanA de do ki unake lie aise bAg2a hai jinake nIce nahareM baha rahIM hogI; jaba bhI unameM se koI phala unheM rojI ke rUpa meM milegA, to kaheMge, 'yaha to vahI haiM jo pahale hameM milA thA,' aura unheM milatA-julatA hI (phala) milegA; unake lie vahA~ pAka-sAfa patni yA~ hogI, aura ve vahA~ sadaiva raheMge

nissaMdeha allAha nahIM zaramAtA ki vaha koI misAla peza kare cAhe vaha ho macchara kI, balki usase bhI bar3hakara kisI tuccha cIz2a kI| phira jo ImAna lAe hai ve to jAnate hai ki vaha unake raba kI ora se satya haiM; rahe inakAra karanevAle to ve kahate hai, 'isa misAla se allAha kA abhiprAya kyA hai?' isase vaha bahutoM ko bhaTakane detA hai aura bahutoM ko sIdhA mArga dikhA detA hai, magara isase vaha kevala avajJAkAriyoM hI ko bhaTakane detA hai

jo allAha kI pratijJA ko use sudRr3ha karane ke pazcAta bhaMga kara dete haiM aura jise allAha ne jor3ane kA Adeza diyA hai use kATa DAlate haiM, aura z2amIna meM bigAr3a paidA karate haiM, vahI haiM jo ghATe meM haiM

tuma allAha ke sAtha avizvAsa kI nIti kaise apanAte ho, jabaki tuma nirjIva the to usane tumheM jIvita kiyA, phira vahI tumheM mauta detA haiM, phira vahI tumheM jIvita karegA, phira usI kI ora tumheM lauTanA haiM?
vahI to hai jisane tumhAre lie z2amIna kI sArI cIz2e paidA kI, phira AkAza kI ora ruqha kiyA aura ThIka taura para sAta AkAza banAe aura vaha hara cIz2a ko jAnatA hai

aura yAda karo jaba tumhAre raba ne phariztoM se kahA ki 'maiM dharatI meM (manuSya ko) khalIfA (sattAdhArI) banAnevAlA hU~|' unhoMne kahA, 'kyA usameM usako rakhegA, jo usameM bigAr3a paidA kare aura raktapAta kare aura hama terA guNagAna karate aura tujhe pavitra kahate haiM?' usane kahA, 'maiM jAnatA hU~ jo tuma nahIM jAnate|'
usane (allAha ne) Adama ko sAre nAma sikhAe, phira unheM fariztoM ke sAmane peza kiyA aura kahA, 'agara tuma sacce ho to mujhe inake nAma batAo|'
ve bole, 'pAka aura mahimAvAna hai tU! tUne jo kucha hameM batAyA usake sivA hameM koI jJAna nahIM| nissaMdeha tU sarvajJa, tatvadarzI hai|'

usane kahA, 'ai Adama! unheM una logoM ke nAma batAo|' phira jaba usane unheM unake nAma batA die to (allAha ne) kahA, 'kyA maiMne tumase kahA na thA ki maiM AkAzoM aura dharatI kI chipI bAtoM ko jAnatA hU~ aura maiM jAnatA hU~ jo kucha tuma z2Ahira karate ho aura jo kucha chipAte ho|'
aura yAda karo jaba hamane fariztoM se kahA ki 'Adama ko sajadA karo' to, unhoMne sajadA kiyA sivAya ibalIla ke; usane inakAra kara diyA aura lagA bar3A banane aura kAfira ho rahA

aura hamane kahA, 'ai Adama! tuma aura tumhArI patnI jannata meM raho aura vahA~ jI bhara beroka-Toka jahA~ se tuma donoM kA jI cAhe khAo, lekina isa vRkSa ke pAsa na jAnA, anyathA tuma z2Alima Thaharoge|'

antataH zaitAna ne unheM vahA~ se phisalA diyA, phira una donoM ko vahA~ se nikalavAkara chor3A, jahA~ ve the| hamane kahA ki 'utaro, tuma eka-dUsare ke zatru hoge aura tumheM eka samaya taka dharatI meM ThaharanA aura bisalanA hai|'
phira Adama ne apane raba se kucha zabda pA lie, to allAha ne usakI taubA qabUla kara lI; nissaMdeha vahI taubA qabUla karane vAlA, atyanta dayAvAna hai

hamane kahA, 'tuma saba yahA~ se utaro, phira yadi tumhAre pAsa merI ora se koI mArgadarzana pahu~ce to jisa kisI ne mere mArgadarzana kA anusaraNa kiyA, to aise logoM ko na to koI bhaya hogA aura na ve zokAkula hoMge|'
aura jina logoM ne inakAra kiyA aura hamArI AyatoM ko jhuThalAyA, vahIM Aga meM par3anevAle haiM, ve usameM sadaiva raheMge
ai isarAIla kA santAna! yAda karo mere usa anugraha ko jo maiMne tumapara kiyA thA| aura merI pratijJA ko pUrA karo, maiM tumase kI huI pratijJA ko pUrA karU~gA aura hA~ mujhI se Daro

aura ImAna lAo usa cIz2a para jo maiMne utArI hai, jo usakI puSTi meM hai, jo tumhAre pAsa hai, aura sabase pahale tuma hI usake inakAra karanevAle na bano| aura merI AyatoM ko thor3A mUlya prApta karane kA sAdhana na banAo, mujhase hI tuma Daro
aura satya meM asatya kA ghAla-mela na karo aura jAnate-bujhate satya ko chipAo mata
aura namAz2a qAyama karo aura z2akAta do aura (mere samakSa) jhukanevAloM ke sAtha jhuko
kyA tuma logoM ko to nekI aura ehasAna kA upadeza dete ho aura apane Apako bhUla jAte ho, hAlA~ki tuma kitAba bhI par3hate ho? phira kyA tuma buddhi se kAma nahIM lete?
dhairya aura namAz2a se madada lo, aura nissaMdeha yaha (namAja) bahuta kaThina hai, kintu una logoM ke lie nahIM jinake dila pighale hue ho;
jo samajhate hai ki unheM apane raba se milanA haiM aura usI kI ora unheM palaTakara jAnA hai
ai isarAIla kI santAna! yAda karo mere usa anugraha ko jo maiMne tumapara kiyA aura ise bhI ki maiMne tumheM sAre saMsAra para zreSThatA pradAna kI thI;

aura Daro usa dina se jaba na koI kisI bhI ora se kucha tAvAna bharegA aura na kisI kI ora se koI sifAriza hI qabUla kI jAegI aura na kisI kI ora se koI fid‌yA (arthadaMDa) liyA jAegA aura na ve sahAyatA hI pA sakeMge|

aura yAda karo jaba hamane tumheM firaauniyoM se chuTakArA dilAyA jo tumheM atyanta burI yAtanA dete the, tumhAre beToM ko mAra DAlate the aura tumhArI striyoM ko jIvita rahane dete the; aura isamaM tumhAre raba kI ora se bar3I parIkSA thI
yAda karo jaba hamane tumheM sAgara meM alaga-alaga caur3e rAste se le jAkara chuTakArA diyA aura firaauniyoM ko tumhArI A~khoM ke sAmane DUbo diyA
aura yAda karo jaba hamane mUsA se cAlIsa rAtoM kA vAdA ThaharAyA to usake pIche tuma bachar3e ko apanA devatA banA baiThe, tuma atyAcArI the
phira isake pazcAta bhI hamane tumheM kSamA kiyA, tAki tuma kRtajJatA dikhAlAo
aura yAda karo jaba mUsA ko hamane kitAba aura kasauTI pradAna kI, tAki tuma mArga pA sako

aura jaba mUsA ne apanI qauma se kahA, 'ai merI kauma ke logo! bachar3e ko devatA banAkara tumane apane Upara z2ulma kiyA hai, to tuma apane paidA karanevAle kI ora palaTo, ataH apane logoM ko svayaM qatla karo| yahI tumhAre paidA karanevAle kI spaSTa meM tumhAre lie acchA hai, phira usane tumhArI taubA qabUla kara lI| nissaMdeha vaha bar3I taubA qabUla karanevAlA, atyanta dayAvAna hai|'
aura yAda karo jaba tumane kahA thA, 'ai mUsA, hama tumapara ImAna nahIM lAe~ge jaba taka allAha ko khullama-khullA na dekha leM|' phira eka kar3aka ne tumheM A dabocA, tuma dekhate rahe
phira tumhAre nirjIva ho jAne ke pazcAta hamane tumheM jilA uThAyA, tAki tuma kRtajJatA dikhalAo

aura hamane tumapara bAdaloM kI chAyA kI aura tumapara 'manna' aura 'salabA' utArA - 'khAo, jo acchI pAka cIjeM hamane tumheM pradAna kI hai|' unhoMne hamArA to kucha bhI nahIM bigAr3A, balki ve apane hI Upara atyAcAra karate rahe

aura jaba hamane kahA thA, 'isa bastI meM praveza karo phira usameM se jahA~ se cAho jI bhara khAo, aura bastI ke dvAra meM sajadAguz2Ara banakara praveza karo aura kaho, 'chUTa haiM|' hama tumhArI khatAoM ko kSamA kara deMge aura acche se acchA kAma karanevAloM para hama aura adhika anugraha kareMge|'
phira jo bAta unase kahIM gaI thI z2AlimoM ne use dUsarI bAta se badala diyA| antataH z2AlimoM para hamane, jo avajJA ve kara rahe the usake kAraNa, AkAza se yAtanA utArI

aura yAda karo jaba mUsA ne apanI qauma ke lie pAnI kI prArthanA ko to hamane kahA, 'caTTAna para apanI lAThI mAro,' to usase bAraha srota phUTa nikale aura hara giroha ne apanA-apanA ghATa jAna liyA - 'khAo aura piyo allAha kA diyA aura dharatI meM bigAr3a phailAte na phiro|'

aura yAda karo jaba tumane kahA thA, 'ai mUsA, hama eka hI prakAra ke khAne para kadApi saMtoSa nahIM kara sakate, ataH hamAre lie apane raba se prArthanA karo ki hamAre vAste dharatI kI upaja se sAga-pAta aura kakar3iyA~ aura lahasuna aura masUra aura pyAz2a nikAle|' aura mUsA ne kahA, 'kyA tuma jo ghaTiyA cIz2a hai usako usase badalakara lenA cAhate ho jo uttama hai? kisI nagara meM utaro, phira jo kucha tumane mA~gA haiM, tumheM mila jAegA' - aura unapara apamAna aura hIna dazA thopa dI gaI, aura allAha ke prakopa ke bhAgI hue| yaha isalie ki ve allAha kI AyatoM kA inakAra karate rahe aura nabiyoM kI akAraNa hatyA karate the| yaha isalie ki unhoMne avajJA kI aura ve sImA kA ullaMghana karate rahe

nissaMdeha, ImAnavAle aura jo yahUdI hue aura IsAI aura sAbiI, jo bhI allAha aura antima dina para ImAna lAyA aura acchA karma kiyA to aise logoM kA unake apane raba ke pAsa (acchA) badalA hai, unako na to koI bhaya hogA aura na ve zokAkula hoMge -

aura yAda karo jaba hamane isa hAla meM ki tUra parvata ko tumhAre Upara U~cA kara rakhA thA, tumase dRr3ha vacana liyA thA, 'jo cIz2a hamane tumheM dI haiM use majabUtI ke sAtha pakar3o aura jo kucha usameM haiM use yAda rakho tAki tuma baca sako|'
phira isake pazcAta bhI tuma phira gae, to yadi allAha kI kRpA aura usakI dayAlutA tuma para na hotI, to tuma ghATe meM par3a gae hote

aura tuma una logoM ke viSaya meM to jAnate hI ho jinhoMne tumameM se 'sabta' ke dina ke mAmale meM maryAdA kA ullaMghana kiyA thA, to hamane unase kaha diyA, 'bandara ho jAo, dhikkAre aura phiTakAre hue!'
phira hamane ise sAmanevAloM aura bAda ke logoM ke lie zikSA-sAmagrI aura Dara rakhanevAloM ke lie nasIhata banAkara chor3A

aura yAda karo jaba mUsA ne apanI qauma se kahA, 'nizcaya hI allAha tumheM Adeza detA hai ki eka gAya jabha karo|' kahane lage, 'kyA tuma hamase parihAsa karate ho?' usane kahA, 'maiM isase allAha kI panAha mA~gatA hU~ ki jAhila banU~|'

bole, 'hamAre lie apane raba se nivedana karo ki vaha hama para spaSTA kara de ki vaha gAya kauna-sI hai?' usane kahA, 'vaha kahatA hai ki vaha aisI gAya hai jo na bUr3hI hai, na bachiyA, inake bIca kI rAsa hai; to jo tumheM hukma diyA jA rahA hai, karo|'

kahane lage, 'hamAre lie apane raba se nivedana karo ki vaha hameM batA de ki usakA raMga kaisA hai?' kahA, 'vaha kahatA hai ki vaha gAya sunaharI hai, gahare caTakIle raMga kI ki dekhanevAloM ko prasanna kara detI hai|'
bole, 'hamAre lie apane raba se nivedana karo ki vaha hameM batA de ki vaha kauna-sI hai, gAyoM kA nirdhAraNa hamAre lie saMdigdha ho rahA hai| yadi allAha ne cAhA to hama avazya| patA lagA leMge|'

usane kahA, ' vaha kahatA haiM ki vaha aisA gAya hai jo sadhAI huI nahIM hai ki bhUmi jotatI ho, aura na vaha kheta ko pAnI detI hai, ThIka-ThAka hai, usameM kisI dUsare raMga kI milAvaTa nahIM hai|' bole, 'aba tumane ThIka bAta batAI hai|' phira unhoMne use z2abha kiyA, jabaki ve karanA nahIM cAhate the
aura yAda karo jaba tumane eka vyakti kI hatyA kara dI, phira usa silasile meM tumane TAla-maTola se kAma liyA - jabaki jisako tuma chipA rahe the, allAha use khola denevAlA thA
to hamane kahA, 'use usake eka hisse se mAro|' isa prakAra allAha murdoM ko jIvita karatA hai aura tumheM apanI nizAniyA~ dikhAtA hai, tAki tuma samajho

phira isake pazcAta bhI tumhAre dila kaThora ho gae, to ve pattharoM kI taraha ho gae balki unase bhI adhika kaThora; kyoMki kucha patthara aise bhI hote hai jinase nahareM phUTa nikalatI hai, aura kucha aise bhI hote hai ki phaTa jAte hai to unameM se pAnI nikalane lagatA hai, aura unameM se kucha aise bhI hote hai jo allAha ke bhaya se gira jAte hai| aura allAha, jo kucha tuma kara rahe ho, usase bekhabara nahIM hai

to kyA tuma isa lAlaca meM ho ki ve tumhArI bAta mAna leMge, jabaki unameM se kucha loga allAha kA kalAma sunate rahe haiM, phira use bhalI-bhA~ti samajha lene ke pazcAta jAna-bUjhakara usameM parivartana karate rahe?

aura jaba ve ImAna lAnevAle se milate hai to kahate haiM, 'hama bhI ImAna rakhate haiM', aura jaba Apasa meM eka-dUsare se ekAnta meM milate hai to kahate hai, 'kyA tuma unheM ve bAteM, jo allAha ne tuma para kholI, batA dete ho ki ve unake dvArA tumhAre raba ke yahA~ hujjata meM tumhArA muqAbilA kareM? to kyA tuma samajhate nahIM!'
kyA ve jAnate nahIM ki allAha vaha saba kucha jAnatA hai, jo kucha ve chipAte aura jo kucha z2Ahira karate haiM?
aura unameM sAmAnya bepar3he bhI haiM jinheM kitAba kA jJAna nahIM hai, basa kucha kAmanAoM evaM AzAoM ko dharma jAnate haiM, aura ve to basa aTakala se kAma lete haiM

to vinAza aura tabAhI hai una logoM ke lie jo apane hAthoM se kitAba likhate haiM phira kahate haiM, 'yaha allAha kI ora se hai', tAki usake dvArA thor3A mUlya prApta kara leM| to tabAhI hai unake hAthoM ne likhA aura tabAhI hai unake lie usake kAraNa jo ve kamA rahe haiM

ve kahate hai, 'jahannama kI Aga hameM nahIM chU sakatI, hA~, kucha gine-cune dinoM kI bAta aura hai|' kaho, 'kyA tumane allAha se koI vacana le rakhA hai? phira to allAha kadApi apane vacana ke viruddha nahIM jA sakatA? yA tuma allAha ke z2imme DAlakara aisI bAta kahate ho jisakA tumheM jJAna nahIM?
kyoM nahIM; jisane bhI koI badI kamAI aura usakI khatAkArI ne use apane ghare meM le liyA, to aise hI loga Aga (jahannama) meM par3anevAle hai; ve usI meM sadaiva raheMge
rahe ve loga jo ImAna lAe aura unhoMne acche karma kie, vahI jannatavAle haiM, ve sadaiva usI meM raheMge|'

aura yAda karo jaba isarAIla kI santAna se hamane vacana liyA, 'allAha ke atirikta kisI kI bandagI na karoge; aura mA~-bApa ke sAtha aura nAtedAroM ke sAtha aura anAthoM aura muhatAjoM ke sAtha acchA vyavahAra karoge; aura yaha ki logoM se bhalI bAta kaho aura namAz2a qAyama karo aura z2akAta do|' to tuma phira gae, basa tumameM se bace thor3e hI, aura tuma upekSA kI nIti hI apanAe rahe
aura yAda karo jaba tumase vacana liyA, 'apane qhUna na bahAoge aura na apane logoM ko apanI bastiyoM se nikAloge|' phira tumane iqarAra kiyA aura tuma svayaM isake gavAha ho

tuma para yuddha anivArya kiyA gayA aura vaha tumheM apriya hai, aura bahuta sambhava hai ki koI cIz2a tumheM apriya ho aura vaha tumhAre lie acchI ho| aura bahuta sambhava hai ki koI cIz2a tumheM priya ho aura vaha tumhAre lie burI ho| aura jAnatA allAha hai, aura tuma nahIM jAnate|'

ve tumase AdaraNIya mahIne meM yuddha ke viSaya meM pUchate hai| kaho, 'usameM lar3anA bar3I gambhIra bAta hai, parantu allAha ke mArga se rokanA, usake sAtha avizvAsa karanA, masjide harAma (kAbA) se rokanA aura usake logoM ko usase nikAlanA, allAha kI spaSTa meM isase bhI adhika gambhIra hai aura fitanA (utpIr3ana), raktapAta se bhI burA hai|' aura usakA basa cale to ve to tumase barAbara lar3ate rahe, tAki tumheM tumhAre dIna (dharma) se phera deM| aura tumame se jo koI apane dIna se phira jAe aura avizvAsI hokara mare, to aise hI loga hai jinake karma duniyA aura Aqhirata meM naSTa ho gae, aura vahI Aga (jahannama) meM par3anevAle hai, ve usI meM sadaiva raheMge
rahe ve loga jo ImAna lAe aura jinhoMne allAha ke mArga meM ghara-bAra chor3A aura jihAda kiyA, vahIM allAha kI dayAlutA kI AzA rakhate hai| nissaMdeha allAha atyanta kSamAzIla, dayAvAna hai

tumase zarAba aura jue ke viSaya meM pUchate hai| kaho, 'una donoM cIz2oM meM bar3A gunAha hai, yadyapi logoM ke lie kucha fAyade bhI hai, parantu unakA gunAha unake fAyade se kahIM baDhakara hai|' aura ve tumase pUchate hai, 'kitanA qharca kareM?' kaho, 'jo AvazyakatA se adhika ho|' isa prakAra allAha duniyA aura Aqhirata ke viSaya meM tumhAre lie apanI Ayate khola-kholakara bayAna karatA hai, tAki tuma soca-vicAra karo|

aura ve tumase anAthoM ke viSaya meM pUchate hai| kaho, 'unake sudhAra kI jo rIti apanAI jAe acchI hai| aura yadi tuma unheM apane sAtha sammilita kara lo to ve tumhAre bhAI-bandhu hI haiM| aura allAha bigAr3a paidA karanevAle ko bacAva paidA karanevAle se alaga pahacAnatA hai| aura yadi allAha cAhatA to tumako z2ahamata (kaThinAI) meM DAla detA| nissaMdeha allAha prabhutvazAlI, tatvadarzI hai|'

aura muzarika (bahudevavAdI) striyoM se vivAha na karo jaba taka ki ve ImAna na lAe~| eka ImAnadArI bAMdI (dAsI), muzarika strI se kahIM uttama hai; cAhe vaha tumheM kitanI hI acchI kyoM na lage| aura na (ImAnavAlI striyA~) muzarika puruSoM se vivAha karo, jaba taka ki ve ImAna na lAe~| eka ImAnavAlA gulAma Az2Ada muzarika se kahIM uttama hai, cAhe vaha tumheM kitanA hI acchA kyoM na lage| aise loga Aga (jahannama) kI ora bulAte hai aura allAha apanI anujJA se jannata aura kSamA kI ora bulAtA hai| aura vaha apanI AyateM logoM ke sAmane khola-kholakara bayAna karatA hai, tAki ve ceteM

aura ve tumase mAsika-dharma ke viSaya meM pUchate hai| kaho, 'vaha eka takalIfa aura gandagI kI cIz2a hai| ataH mAsika-dharma ke dinoM meM striyoM se alaga raho aura unake pAsa na jAo, jabataka ki ve pAka-sAfa na ho jAe~| phira jaba ve bhalI-bhA~ti pAka-sAfa ho jAe, to jisa prakAra allAha ne tumheM batAyA hai, unake pAsa Ao| nissaMdeha allAha bahuta taubA karanevAloM ko pasanda karatA hai aura vaha unheM pasanda karatA hai jo svacchatA ko pasanda karate hai

tumhArI striyoM tumhArI khetI hai| ataH jisa prakAra cAho tuma apanI khetI meM Ao aura apane lie Age bhejo; aura allAha se Darate raho; bhalI-bhA~ti jAna le ki tumheM usase milanA hai; aura ImAna lAnevAloM ko zubha-sUcanA de do

apane neka aura dharmaparAyaNa hone aura logoM ke madhya sudhAraka hone ke silasile meM apanI qasamoM ke dvArA allAha ko Ar3a aura nizAnA na banAo ki ina kAmoM ko chor3a do| allAha saba kucha sunatA, jAnatA hai

allAha tumheM tumhArI aisI kasamoM para nahIM pakar3egA jo yU~ hI mu~ha se nikala gaI ho, lekina una qasamoM para vaha tumheM avazya pakar3egA jo tumhAre dila ke irAde kA natIjA hoM| allAha bahuta kSamA karanevAlA, sahanazIla hai
jo loga apanI striyoM se alaga rahane kI qasama khA baiTheM, unake lie cAra mahIne kI pratikSA hai| phira yadi ve palaTa Ae~, to allAha atyanta kSamAzIla, dayAvAna hai
aura yadi ve talAqa hI kI ThAna leM, to allAha bhI sunanevAlA bhalI-bhA~ti jAnanevAlA hai

aura talAqa pAI huI striyA~ tIna haiz2a (mAsika-dharma) guz2arane taka apane-Apa ko roke rakhe, aura yadi ve allAha aura antima dina para ImAna rakhatI hai to unake lie yaha vaidha na hogA ki allAha ne unake garbhAzayoM meM jo kucha paidA kiyA ho use chipAe~| isa bIca unake pati, yadi sambandhoM ko ThIka kara lene kA irAdA rakhate hoM, to ve unheM lauTA lene ke z2yAdA haqadAra hai| aura una patniyoM ke bhI sAmAnya niyama ke anusAra vaise hI adhikAra haiM, jaisI una para z2immedAriyA~ DAlI gaI hai| aura patiyoM ko unapara eka darjA prApta hai| allAha atyanta prabhutvazAlI, tatvadarzI hai

talAqa do bAra hai| phira sAmAnya niyama ke anusAra (strI ko) roka liyA jAe yA bhale tarIqe se vidA kara diyA jAe| aura tumhAre lie vaidha nahIM hai ki jo kucha tuma unheM de cuke ho, usameM se kucha le lo, sivAya isa sthiti ke ki donoM ko Dara ho ki allAha kI (nirdhArita) sImAoM para qAyama na raha sakeMge to yadi tumako yaha Dara ho ki ve allAha kI sImAo para qAyama na raheMge to strI jo kucha dekara chuTakArA prApta karanA cAhe usameM una dono ke lie koI gunAha nahIM| ye allAha kI sImAe~ hai| ataH inakA ullaMghana na karo| aura jo koI allAha kI sImAoM kA ullaMghana kare to aise loga atyAcArI hai

(do talAqo ke pazcAta) phira yadi vaha use talAqa de de, to isake pazcAta vaha usake lie vaidha na hogI, jabataka ki vaha usake atirikta kisI dUsare pati se nikAha na kara le| ataH yadi vaha use talAqa de de to phira una donoM ke lie eka-dUsare ko palaTa Ane meM koI gunAha na hogA, yadi ve samajhate ho ki allAha kI sImAoM para qAyama raha sakate hai| aura ye allAha ki nirdhArita kI huI sImAe~ hai, jinheM vaha una logoM ke lie bayAna kara rahA hai jo jAnanA cAhate ho

aura yadi jaba tuma striyoM ko talAqa de do aura ve apanI nizcita avadhi (iddata) ko pahu~ca jAe~, jo sAmAnya niyama ke anusAra unheM roka lo yA sAmAnya niyama ke anusAra unheM vidA kara do| aura tuma unheM nuqasAna pahu~cAne ke dhyeya se na roko ki z2yAdatI karo| aura jo aisA karegA, to usane svayaM apane hI Upara z2ulma kiyA| aura allAha kI AyatoM ko parihAsa kA viSaya na banAo, aura allAha kI kRpA jo tuma para huI hai use yAda rakho aura usa kitAba aura tatvadarzitA (hikamata) ko yAda rakho jo usane tuma para utArI hai, jisake dvArA vaha tumheM nasIhata karatA hai| aura allAha kA Dara rakho aura bhalI-bhA~ti jAna lo ki allAha hara cIja ko jAnanevAlA hai

aura jaba tuma striyoM ko talAqa de do aura ve apanI nirdhArita avadhi (iddata) ko pahu~ca jAe~, to unheM apane honevAle dUsare patiyoM se vivAha karane se na roko, jabaki ve sAmAnya niyama ke anusAra paraspara raz2AmandI se mAmalA taya kareM| yaha nasIhata tumameM se usako kI jA rahI hai jo allAha aura antima dina para ImAna rakhatA hai| yahI tumhAre lie z2yAdA barakatavAlA aura sutharA tarIqA hai| aura allAha jAnatA hai, tuma nahIM jAnate

aura jo koI pUrI avadhi taka (bacce ko) dUdha pilavAnA cAhe, to mAe~ apane baccoM ko pUre do varSa taka dUdha pilAe~| aura vaha jisakA baccA hai, sAmAnya niyama ke anusAra unake khAne aura unake kapar3e kA z2immedAra hai| kisI para basa usakI apanI samAI bhara hI z2immedArI hai, na to koI mA~ apane bacce ke kAraNa (bacce ke bApa ko) nuqasAna pahu~cAe aura na bApa apane bacce ke kAraNa (bacce kI mA~ ko) nuqasAna pahu~cAe| aura isI prakAra kI z2immedArI usake vArisa para bhI AtI hai| phira yadi donoM pArasparika svecchA aura parAmarza se dUdha chur3AnA cAheM to unapara koI gunAha nahIM| aura yadi tuma apanI saMtAna ko kisI anya strI se dUdha pilavAnA cAho to isameM bhI tuma para koI gunAha nahIM, jabaki tumane jo kucha badale meM dene kA vAdA kiyA ho, sAmAnya niyama ke anusAra use cukA do| aura allAha kA Dara rakho aura bhalI-bhA~ti jAna lo ki jo kucha tuma karate ho, allAha use dekha rahA hai

aura tumameM se jo loga mara jAe~ aura apane pIche patniyoM chor3a jAe~, to ve patniyoM apane-Apako cAra mahIne aura dasa dina taka roke rakheM| phira jaba ve apanI nirdhArita avadhi (iddata) ko pahu~ca jAe~, to sAmAnya niyama ke anusAra ve apane lie jo kucha kareM, usameM tumapara koI gunAha nahIM| jo kucha tuma karate ho, allAha usakI qhabara rakhatA hai

aura isameM bhI tuma para koI gunAha nahIM jo tuma una auratoM ko vivAha ke sandeza sAMketika rUpa se do yA apane mana meM chipAe rakho| allAha jAnatA hai ki tuma unheM yAda karoge, parantu chipakara unheM vacana na denA, sivAya isake ki sAmAnya niyama ke anusAra koI bAta kaha do| aura jaba taka nirdhArita avadhi (iddata) pUrI na ho jAe, vivAha kA nAtA jor3ane kA nizcaya na karo| jAna rakho ki allAha tumhAre mana kI bAta bhI jAnatA hai| ataH usase sAvadhAna raho aura allAha atyanta kSamA karanevAlA, sahanazIla hai

yadi tuma striyoM ko isa sthiti me talAqa de do ki yaha naubata peza na AI ho ki tumane unheM hAtha lagAyA ho aura unakA kucha haqa (mahrana) nizcita kiyA ho, to tumapara koI bhAra nahIM| hA~, sAmAnya niyama ke anusAra unheM kucha qharca do - samAI rakhanevAle para usakI apanI haisiyata ke anusAra aura taMgadasta para usakI apanI haisiyata ke anusAra anivArya hai - yaha acche logoM para eka haqa hai

aura yadi tuma unheM hAtha lagAne se pahale talAqa de do, kintu usakA mahra- nizcita kara cuke ho, to jo mahraha tumane nizcita kiyA hai usakA AdhA adA karanA hogA, yaha aura bAta hai ki ve svayaM chor3a de yA puruSa jisake hAtha meM vivAha kA sUtra hai, vaha narmI se kAma le (aura mahra pUrA adA kara de) | aura yaha ki tuma narmI se kAma lo to yaha parahez2agArI se z2yAdA qarIba hai aura tuma eka-dUsare ko haqa se bar3hakara denA na bhUlo| nizcaya hI allAha use dekha rahA hai, jo tuma karate ho
sadaiva namAz2o kI aura acchI namAz2oM kI pAbandI karo, aura allAha ke Age pUre vinIta aura zAntabhAva se khar3e huA karo

phira yadi tumheM (zatru Adi kA) bhaya ho, to paidala yA savAra jisa taraha sambhava ho namAz2a par3ha lo| phira jaba nizcinta ho to allAha ko usa prakAra yAda karo jaisAki usane tumheM sikhAyA hai, jise tuma nahIM jAnate the

aura tumameM se jina logoM kI mRtyu ho jAe aura apane pIche patniyoM chor3a jAe, arthAta apanI patniyoM ke haqa meM yaha vasIyata chor3a jAe ki ghara se nikAle binA eka varSa taka unheM qharca diyA jAe, to yadi ve nikala jAe~ to apane lie sAmAnya niyama ke anusAra ve jo kucha bhI kareM usameM tumhAre lie koI doSa nahIM| allAha atyanta prabhutvazAlI, tatvadarzI hai
aura talAqa pAI huI striyoM ko sAmAnya niyama ke anusAra (iddata kI avadhi meM) qharca bhI milanA cAhie| yaha Dara rakhanevAlo para eka haqa hai
isa prakAra allAha tumhAre lie apanI AyateM kholakara bayAna karatA hai, tAki tuma samajha se kAma lo

kyA tumane una logoM ko nahIM dekhA jo haz2AroM kI saMkhyA meM hone para bhI mRtyu ke bhaya se apane ghara-bAra chor3akara nikale the? to allAha ne unase kahA, 'mRtyu prAya ho jAo tuma|' phira usane unheM jIvana pradAna kiyA| allAha to logoM ke lie udAra anugrAhI hai, kintu adhikatara loga kRtajJatA nahIM dikhalAte
aura allAha ke mArga meM yuddha karo aura jAna lo ki allAha saba kucha sunanevAlA, jAnanevAle hai
kauna hai jo allAha ko acchA RNa de ki allAha use usake lie kaI gunA bar3hA de? aura allAha hI taMgI bhI detA hai aura kuzAdagI bhI pradAna karatA hai, aura usI kI ora tumheM lauTanA hai

kyA tumane mUsA ke pazcAta isarAIla kI santAna ke saradAroM ko nahIM dekhA, jaba unhoMne apane eka nabI se kahA, 'hamAre lie eka samrATa niyukta kara do tAki hama allAha ke mArga meM yuddha kareM?' usane kahA, 'yadi tumheM lar3AI kA Adeza diyA jAe to kyA tumhAre bAre meM yaha sambhAvanA nahIM hai ki tuma na lar3o?' ve kahane lage, 'hama allAha ke mArga meM kyoM na lar3e, jabaki hama apane gharoM se nikAla die gae hai aura apane bAla-baccoM se bhI alaga kara die gae hai?' - phira jaba unapara yuddha anivArya kara diyA gayA to unameM se thor3e logoM ke sivA saba phira gae| aura allAha z2AlimoM ko bhalI-bhA~ti jAnatA hai| -

unase nabI ne unase kahA, 'allAha ne tumhAre lie tAlUta ko samrATa niyukta kiyA hai|' bole, 'usakI bAdazAhI hama para kaise ho sakatI hai, jababaki hama usake muqAbale meM bAdazAhI ke z2yAdA haqadAra hai aura jabaki usa mAla kI kuzAdagI bhI prApta nahIM hai?' usane kahA, 'allAha ne tumhAre muqAbale meM usako hI cunA hai aura use jJAna meM aura zArIrika kSamatA meM z2yAdA kuzAdagI pradAna kI hai| allAha jisako cAhe apanA rAjya pradAna kare| aura allAha bar3I samAIvAlA, sarvajJa hai|'

unake nabI ne unase kahA, 'usakI bAdazAhI kI nizAnI yaha hai ki vaha saMdUka tumhAre para A jAegA, jisameM tumhAre raha kI ora se sakInata (prazAnti) aura mUsA ke logoM aura hArUna ke logoM kI chor3I huI yAdagAreM haiM, jisako farizte uThAe hue hoMge| yadi tuma ImAnavAle ho to, nissaMdeha isameM tumhAre lie bar3I nizAnI hai|'

phira taba tAlUta senAe~ lekara calA to unane kahA, 'allAha nizcita rUpa se eka nadI dvArA tumhArI parIkSA lenevAlA hai| to jisane usakA pAnI pI liyA, vaha mujhameM se nahIM hai aura jisane usako nahIM cakhA, vahI mujhameM se hai| yaha aura bAta hai ki koI apane hAtha se eka cullU bhara le le|' phira unameM se thor3e logoM ke sivA sabhI ne usakA pAnI pI liyA, phira jaba tAlUta aura ImAnavAle jo usake sAtha the nadI pAra kara gae to kahane lage, 'Aja hamameM jAlUta aura usakI senAoM kA muqAbalA karane kI zakti nahIM haiM|' isa para logoM ne, jo samajhate the ki unheM allAha se milanA hai, kahA, 'kitanI hI bAra eka choTI-sI Tukar3I ne allAha kI anujJA se eka bar3e giroha para vijaya pAI hai| allAha to jamanevAlo ke sAtha hai|'
aura jaba ve jAlUta aura usakI senAoM ke muqAbale para Ae to kahA, 'ai hamAre raba! hamapara dhairya uDela de aura hamAre qadama jamA de aura inakAra karanevAle logoM para hameM vijaya pradAna kara|'

antataH allAha kI anujJA se unhoMne unako parAjita kara diyA aura dAUda ne jAlUta ko qatla kara diyA, aura allAha ne use rAjya aura tatvadarzitA (hikamata) pradAna kI, jo kucha vaha (dAUda) cAhe, usase usako avagata karAyA| aura yadi allAha manuSyoM ke eka giroha ko dUsare giroha ke dvArA haTAtA na rahatA to dharatI kI vyavasthA bigar3a jAtI, kintu allAha saMsAravAloM ke lie udAra anugrAhI hai
ye allAha kI saccI AyateM hai jo hama tumheM (soddezya) sunA rahe hai aura nizcaya hI tuma una logoM meM se ho, jo rasUsa banAkara bheje gae hai

ye rasUla aise hue hai ki inameM hamane kucha ko kucha para zreSThatA pradAna kI| inameM kucha se to allAha ne bAtacIta kI aura inameM se kucha ko darjoM kI spaSTa se uccatA pradAna kI| aura marayama ke beTe IsA ko hamane khulI nizAniyA~ dI aura pavitra AtmA se usakI sahAyatA kI| aura yadi allAha cAhatA to ve loga, jo unake pazcAta hue, khulI nizAniyA~ pA lene ke bAda paraspara na lar3ate| kintu ve vibheda meM par3a gae to unameM se koI to ImAna lAyA aura unameM se kisI ne inakAra kI nIti apanAI| aura yadi allAha cAhatA to ve paraspara na lar3ate, parantu allAha jo cAhatA hai, karatA hai

ai ImAna lAnevAlo! hamane jo kucha tumheM pradAna kiyA hai usameM se qharca karo, isase pahale ki vaha dina A jAe jisameM na koI kraya-vikraya hogA aura na koI mitratA hogI aura na koI sifAriza| z2Alima vahI hai, jinhoMne inakAra kI nIti apanAI hai

allAha ki jisake sivA koI pUjya-prabhu nahIM, vaha jIvanta-sattA hai, sabako sa~bhAlane aura qAyama rakhanevAlA hai| use na U~gha lagatI hai aura na nidrA| usI kA hai jo kucha AkAzoM meM hai aura jo kucha dharatI meM hai| kauna hai jo usake yahA~ usakI anumati ke binA sifAriza kara sake? vaha jAnatA hai jo kucha unake Age hai aura jo kucha unake pIche hai| aura ve usake jJAna meM se kisI cIz2a para hAvI nahIM ho sakate, sivAya usake jo usane cAhA| usakI kursI (prabhutA) AkAzoM aura dharatI ko vyApta hai aura unakI surakSA usake lie tanika bhI bhArI nahIM aura vaha ucca, mahAna hai

dharma ke viSaya meM koI z2abaradastI nahIM| sahI bAta nAsamajhI kI bAta se alaga hokara spaSTa ho gaI hai| to aba jo koI bar3he hue sarakaza ko ThukarA de aura allAha para ImAna lAe, usane aisA maz2abUta sahArA thAma liyA jo kabhI TUTanevAlA nahIM| allAha saba kucha sunane, jAnanevAlA hai

jo loga ImAna lAte hai, allAha unakA rakSaka aura sahAyaka hai| vaha unheM a~dheroM se nikAlakara prakAza kI ora le jAtA hai| rahe ve loga jinhoMne inakAra kiyA to unake saMrakSaka bar3he hue sarakaza hai| ve unheM prakAza se nikAlakara a~dheroM kI ora le jAte hai| vahI Aga (jahannama) meM par3anevAle hai| ve usI meM sadaiva raheMge

kyA tumane unako nahIM dekhA, jisane ibarAhIma se usake 'raba' ke silasile meM jhagar3A kiyA thA, isa kAraNa ki allAha ne usako rAjya de rakhA thA? jaba ibarAhIma ne kahA, 'merA 'raba' vaha hai jo jilAtA aura mAratA hai|' usane kahA, 'maiM bhI to jilAtA aura mAratA hU~|' ibarAhIma ne kahA, 'acchA to allAha sUrya ko pUraba se lAtA hai, to tU use pazcima se le A|' isapara vaha adharmI cakita raha gayA| allAha z2Alima logoM ko sIdhA mArga nahIM dikhAtA

kaha do, 'yadi tuma apane diloM kI bAta chipAo yA use prakaTa karo, pratyeka dazA meM allAha use jAna legA| aura vaha use bhI jAnatA hai, jo kucha AkAzoM meM hai aura jo kucha dharatI meM hai| aura allAha ko hara cIz2a kI sAmarthya prApta hai|'

kaha do, 'yadi tuma allAha se prema karate ho to merA anusaraNa karo, allAha bhI tumase prema karegA aura tumhAre gunAhoM ko kSamA kara degA| allAha bar3A kSamAzIla, dayAvAna hai|'
kaha do, 'allAha aura rasUla kA AjJApAlana karo|' phira yadi ve mu~ha mor3e to allAha bhI inakAra karanevAloM se prema nahIM karatA
allAha ne Adama, nUha, ibarAhIma kI santAna aura imarAna kI santAna ko sAre saMsAra kI apekSA prAthamikatA dekara cunA
eka nasta ke rUpa meM, usameM se eka pIr3hI, dUsarI pIr3hI se paidA huI| allAha saba kucha sunatA, jAnatA hai

yAda karo jaba imarAna kI strI ne kahA, 'mere raba! jo baccA mere peTa meM hai use maiMne hara cIz2a se chur3Akara bheTa svarUpa tujhe arpita kiyA| ataH tU use merI ora se svIkAra kara| nissaMdeha tU saba kucha sunatA, jAnatA hai|'

phira jaba usake yahA~ baccI paidA huI to usane kahA, 'mere raba! mere yahA~ to lar3akI paidA huI hai|' - allAha to jAnatA hI thA jo kucha usake yahA~ paidA huA thA| aura vaha lar3akA usa laDakI kI taraha nahIM ho sakatA - 'aura maiMne usakA nAma marayama rakhA hai aura maiM use aura usakI santAna ko tiraskRta zaitAna (ke upadrava) se surakSita rakhane ke lie terI zaraNa meM detI hU~|'

ataH usake raba ne usakA acchI svIkRti ke sAtha svAgata kiyA aura uttama rUpa meM use paravAna car3hAyA; aura z2akariyA ko usakA saMrakSaka banAyA| jaba kabhI z2akariyA usake pAsa meharAba (ibAdatagAha) meM jAtA, to usake pAsa kucha roz2I pAtA| usane kahA, 'ai marayama! ye cIz2e tujhe kahA~ se milatI hai?' usane kahA, 'yaha allAha ke pAsa se hai|' nissaMdeha allAha jise cAhatA hai, behisAba detA hai
vahI z2akariyA ne apane raba ko pukArA, kahA, 'mere raba! mujhe tU apane pAsa se acchI santAna (anuyAyI) pradAna kara| tU hI prArthanA kA sunanevAlA hai|'

to fariztoM ne use AvAz2a dI, jabaki vaha meharAba meM khar3A namAz2a par3ha rahA thA, 'allAha, tujhe yahyAi kI zubha-sUcanA detA hai, jo allAha ke eka kalimeM kI puSTi karanevAlA, saradAra, atyanta saMyamI aura acche logo meM se eka nabI hogA|'
usane kahA, 'mere raba! mere yahA~ lar3akA kaise paidA hogA, jabaki mujhe buDhApA A gayA hai aura merI patn2I bA~jha hai?' kahA, 'isI prakAra allAha jo cAhatA hai, karatA hai|'

usane kahA, 'mere raba! mere lie koI Adeza nizcita kara de|' kahA, 'tumhAre lie Adeza yaha hai ki tuma logoM se tIna dina taka saMketa ke sivA koI bAtacIta na karo| apane raba ko bahuta adhika yAda karo aura sAyaMkAla aura prAtaH samaya usakI tasabIha (mahimAgAna) karate raho|'
aura jaba fariztoM ne kahA, 'ai marayama! allAha ne tujhe cuna liyA aura tujhe pavitratA pradAna kI aura tujhe saMsAra kI striyoM ke muqAbale maM cuna liyA
'ai marayama! pUrI niSThA ke sAtha apane raba kI AjJA kA pAlana karatI raha, aura sajadA kara aura jhukanevAloM ke sAtha tU bhI jhUkatI raha|'

yaha parokSa kI sUcanAoM meM se hai, jisakI vahya hama tumhArI ora kara rahe hai| tuma to usa samaya unake pAsa nahIM the, jaba ve apanI qalamoM ko pheMka rahe tha ki unameM kauna marayama kA saMrakSaka bane aura na unake samaya the, jaba ve Apasa meM jhagar3a rahe the

ora yAda karo jaba fariztoM ne kahA, 'ai marayama! allAha tujhe apane eka kalime (bAta) kI zubha-sUcanA detA hai, jisakA nAma masIha, marayama kA beTA, IsA hogA| vaha duniyA aura Aqhirata me AbarUvAlA hogA aura allAha ke nikaTavartI logoM meM se hogA
vaha logoM se pAlane meM bhI bAta karegA aura bar3I Ayu ko pahu~cakara bhI| aura vaha neka vyakti hogA| -

vaha bolI, 'mere raba! mere yahA~ lar3akA kahA~ se hogA, jabaki mujhe kisI AdamI ne chuA taka nahIM?' kahA, 'aisA hI hogA, allAha jo cAhatA hai, paidA karatA hai| jaba vaha kisI kArya kA nirNaya karatA hai to usako basa yahI kahatA hai 'ho jA' to vaha ho jAtA hai
'aura usako kitAba, hikamata, taurAta aura iMjIla kA bhI jJAna degA

'aura use isarAIla kI saMtAna kI ora rasUla banAkara bhejegA| (vaha kahegA) ki maiM tumhAre pAsa tumhAre raba kI ora se eka nizAlI lekara AyA hU~ ki maiM tumhAre lie miTTI se pakSI ke rUpa jaisI AkRti banAtA hU~, phira usameM phU~ka mAratA hU~, to vaha allAha ke Adeza se ur3ane lagatI hai| aura maiM allAha ke Adeza se aMdhe aura kor3hI ko acchA kara detA hU~ aura murde ko jIvita kara detA hU~| aura maiM tumheM batA detA hU~ jo kucha tuma khAte ho aura jo kucha apane gharoM meM ikaTThA karake rakhate ho| nissaMdeha isameM tumhAre lie eka nizAnI hai, yadi tuma mAnanevAle ho

'aura maiM taurAta kI, jo mere Age hai, puSTi karatA hU~ aura isalie AyA hU~ ki tumhAre lie kucha una cIz2oM ko halAla kara dU~ jo tumhAre lie harAma thI| aura maiM tumhAre pAsa tumhAre raba kI ora se eka nizAnI lekara AyA hU~| ataH allAha kA Dara rakho aura merI AjJA kA pAlana karo
'nissaMdeha allAha merI bhI raba hai aura tumhArA raba bhI, ataH tuma usI kI bandagI karo| yahI sIdhA mArga hai|'

phira jaba IsA ko unake avizvAsa aura inakAra kA AbhAsa huA to usane kahA, 'kauna allAha kI ora bar3hane meM merA sahAyaka hotA hai?' havAriyoM (sAthiyoM) ne kahA, 'hama allAha ke sahAyaka haiM| hama allAha para ImAna lAe aura gavAha rahie ki hama muslima hai
'hamAre raba! tUne jo kucha utArA hai, hama usapara ImAna lAe aura isa rasUla kA anusaraNa svIkAra kiyA| ataH tU hameM gavAhI denevAloM meM likha le|'
aura ve cAla cale to allAha ne bhI usakA tor3a kiyA aura allAha uttama tor3a karanevAlA hai

jaba allAha ne kahA, 'ai IsA! maiM tujhe apane qabje meM le lU~gA aura tujhe apanI ora uThA lU~gA aura avizvAsiyoM (kI kuceSTAoM) se tujhe pAka kara dU~gA aura tere anuyAyiyoM ko qiyAmata ke dina taka logoM ke Upara rakhU~gA, jinhoMne inakAra kiyA| phira merI ora tumheM lauTanA hai| phira maiM tumhAre bIca una cIz2oM kA faisalA kara dU~gA, jinake viSaya meM tuma vibheda karate rahe ho
'to jina logoM ne inakAra kI nIti apanAI, unheM duniyA aura Aqhirata meM kar3I yAtanA dU~gA| unakA koI sahAyaka na hogA|'
rahe ve loga jo ImAna lAe aura unhoMne acche karma kie unheM vaha unakA pUrA-pUrA badalA degA| allAha atyAcAriyoM se prema nahIM karatA
ye AyateM hai aura hikamata (tatvajJAna) se paripUrNa anusmAraka, jo hama tumheM sunA rahe haiM
nissaMdeha allAha kI dRSTi meM IsA kI misAla Adama jaisI hai ki use miTTI se banAyA, phira usase kahA, 'ho jA', to vaha ho jAtA hai
yaha haqa tumhAre raba kI ora se haiM, to tuma saMdeha meM na par3anA

aba isake pazcAta ki tumhAre pAsa jJAna A cukA hai, koI tumase isa viSaya meM kutarka kare to kaha do, 'Ao, hama apane beToM ko bulA leM aura tuma bhI apane beToM ko bulA lo, aura hama apanI striyoM ko bulA leM aura tuma bhI apanI striyoM ko bulA lo, aura hama apane ko aura tuma apane ko le Ao, phira milakara prArthanA kareM aura jhUThoM para allAha kI lAnata bheje|'
nissaMdeha yahI saccA bayAna hai aura allAha ke atirikta koI pUjya nahIM| aura allAha hI prabhutvazAlI, tatvadarzI hai
phira yadi ve loga mu~ha mor3e to allAha fasAdiyoM ko bhalI-bhA~ti jAnatA hai

kaho, 'ai kitAbavAlo! Ao eka aisI bAta kI ora jise hamAre aura tumhAre bIca samAna mAnyatA prApta hai; yaha ki hama allAha ke atirikta kisI kI bandagI na kareM aura na usake sAtha kisI cIz2a ko sAjhI ThaharAe~ aura na paraspara hamameM se koI eka-dUsare ko allAha se haTakara raba banAe|' phira yadi ve mu~ha mor3e to kaha do, 'gavAha raho, hama to muslima (AjJAkArI) hai|'
'ai kitAbavAlo! tuma ibarAhIma ke viSaya meM hamase kyoM jhagar3ate ho? jabaki taurAta aura iMjIla to usake pazcAta utArI gaI hai, to kyA tuma samajha se kAma nahIM lete?

'ye tuma loga ho ki usake viSaya meM vAda-vivAda kara cuke jisakA tumheM kucha jJAna thA| aba usake viSaya meM kyoM vAda-vivAda karate ho, jisake viSaya meM tumheM kucha bhI jJAna nahIM? allAha jAnatA hai, tuma nahIM jAnate'
ibarAhIma na yahUdI thA aura na IsAI, balki vaha to eka ora ko hokara rahanevAlA muslima (AjJAkArI) thA| vaha kadApi muzarikoM meM se na thA

nissaMdeha ibarAhIma se sabase adhika nikaTatA kA sambandha rakhanevAle ve loga hai jinhoMne usakA anusaraNa kiyA, aura yaha nabI aura ImAnavAle loga| aura allAha ImAnavAloM ko samarthaka evaM sahAyaka hai
kitAbavAloM meM se eka giroha ke logoM kI kAmanA hai ki kAza! ve tumheM pathabhraSTa kara sakeM, jabaki ve kevala apane-ApakoM pathabhraSTa kara rahe hai! kintu unheM isakA ehasAsa nahIM
ai kitAbavAloM! tuma allAha kI AyatoM kA inakAra kyoM karate ho, jabaki tuma svayaM gavAha ho?
ai kitAbavAlo! satya ko asatya ke sAtha kyoM gaDDa-maDDa karate aura jAnate-bUjhate hue satya ko chipAte ho?
kitAbavAloM meM se eka giroha kahatA hai, 'ImAnavAlo para jo kucha utarA hai, usa para prAtaHkAla ImAna lAo aura saMdhyA samaya usakA inakAra kara do, tAki ve phira jAe~

'aura tuma apane dharma ke anuyAyiyoM ke atirikta kisI para vizvAsa na karo| kaha do, vAstavika mArgadarzana to allAha kA mArgadarzana hai - ki kahIM jo cIz2a tumheM prApta ho jAe, yA ve tumhAre raba ke sAmane tumhAre qhilAfa hujjata kara sakeM|' kaha do, 'bar3ha-car3hakara pradAna karanA to allAha ke hAtha meM hai, jise cAhatA hai pradAna karatA hai| aura allAha bar3I samAIvAlA, saba kucha jAnanevAlA hai
'vaha jise cAhatA hai apanI rahamata (dayAlutA) ke lie qhAsa kara letA hai| aura allAha bar3I udAratA darzAnevAlA hai|'

aura kitAbavAloM meM koI to aisA hai ki yadi tuma usake pAsa dhana-daulaca kA eka Dhera bhI amAnata rakha do to vaha use tumheM lauTA degA| aura unameM koI aisA hai ki yadi tuma eka dInAra bhI usakI amAnata meM rakhoM, to jaba taka ki tuma usake sira para savAra na ho, vaha use tumheM adA nahIM karegA| yaha isalie ki ve kahate hai, 'una logoM ke viSaya meM jo kitAbavAle nahIM haiM hamArI koI pakar3a nahIM|' aura ve jAnate-bUjhate allAha para jhUTha mar3hate hai
kyoM nahIM, jo koI apanI pratijJA pUrI karegA aura Dara rakhegA, to allAha bhI Dara rakhanevAloM se prema karatA hai

rahe ve loga jo allAha kI pratijJA aura apanI qasamoM kA thor3e mUlya para saudA karate haiM, unakA Aqhirata meM koI hissA nahIM| allAha na to unase bAta karegA aura na qiyAmata ke dina unakI ora dekhegA, aura na hI unheM nikhAregA| unake lie to dukhada yAtanA hai

unameM kucha loga aise hai jo kitAba par3hate hue apanI z2abAnoM kA isa prakAra ulaTa-phera karate hai ki tuma samajhoM ki vaha kitAba hI meM se hai, jabaki vaha kitAba meM se nahIM hotA| aura ve kahate hai, 'yaha allAha kI ora se hai|' jabaki vaha allAha kI ora se nahIM hotA| aura ve jAnate-bUjhate jhUTha gar3hakara allAha para thopate hai

kisI manuSya ke lie yaha sambhava na thA ki allAha use kitAba aura hikamata (tatvadarzitA) aura paig2ambarI pradAna kare aura vaha logoM se kahane lage, 'tuma allAha ko chor3akara mere upAsaka bano|' balki vaha to yahI kahegA ki, 'tuma rabavAle bano, isalie ki tuma kitAba kI zikSA dete ho aura isalie ki tuma svayaM bhI par3hate ho|'
aura na vaha tumheM isa bAta kA hukma degA ki tuma fariztoM aura nabiyoM ko apanA raba banA lo| kyA vaha tumheM adharma kA hukma degA, jabaki tuma (usake) AjJAkArI ho?

aura yAda karo jaba allAha ne nabiyoM ke sambandha meM vacana liyA thA, 'maiMne tumheM jo kucha kitAba aura hikamata pradAna kI, isake pazcAta tumhAre pAsa koI rasUla usakI puSTi karatA huA Ae jo tumhAre pAsa maujUda hai, to tuma avazya usa para ImAna lAoge aura nizcaya hI usakI sahAyatA karoge|' kahA, 'kyA tumane iqarAra kiyA? aura isapara merI ora se DAlI huI jimmedArI ko bojha uThAyA?' unhoMne kahA, 'hamane iqarAra kiyA|' kahA, 'acchA to gavAha kiyA aura maiM bhI tumhAre sAtha gavAha hU~|'
phira isake bAda jo phira gae, to aise hI loga avajJAkArI hai

aba kyA ina logoM ko allAha ke dIna (dharma) ke sivA kisI aura dIna kI talaba hai, hAlA~ki AkAzoM aura dharatI meM jo koI bhI hai, svecchApUrvaka yA vivaza hokara usI ke Age jhukA huA hai| aura usI kI ora sabako lauTanA hai?

kaho, 'hama to allAha para aura usa cIz2a para ImAna lAe jo hama para utarI hai, aura jo ibarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAqa aura yAkUba़ aura unakI santAna para utarI usapara bhI, aura jo mUsA aura IsA aura dUsare nabiyo ko unake raba kI ora se pradAna huI (usapara bhI hama ImAna rakhate hai) | hama unameM se kisI ko usa ora se pradAna huI (usapara bhI hama ImAna rakhate hai) | hama unameM se kisI ko usa sambandha se alaga nahIM karate jo unake bIca pAyA jAtA hai, aura hama usI ke AjJAkArI (muslima) hai|'
jo islAma ke atirikta koI aura dIna (dharma) talaba karegA to usakI ora se kucha bhI svIkAra na kiyA jAegA| aura Aqhirata meM vaha ghATA uThAnevAloM meM se hogA

allAha una logoM ko kaise mArga dikhAegA, jinhoMne apane ImAna ke pazcAta adharma aura inakAra kI nIti apanAI, jabaki ve svayaM isa bAta kI gavAhI de cuke haiM ki yaha rasUla saccA hai aura unake pAsa spaSTa nizAniyA~ bhI A cukI haiM? allAha atyAcArI logoM ko mArga nahIM dikhAyA karatA
una logoM kA badalA yahI hai ki unapara allAha aura fariztoM aura sAre manuSyoM kI lAnata hai
isI dazA meM ve sadaiva raheMge, na unakI yAtanA halkI hogI aura na unheM muhalata hI dI jAegI
hA~, jina logoM ne isake pazcAta taubA kara lI aura apanI nIti ko sudhAra liyA to nissaMdeha allAha bar3A kSamAzIla, dayAvAna hai
rahe ve loga jinhoMne apane ImAna ke pazcAta inakAra kiyA aura apane inakAra meM bar3hate hI gae, unakI taubA kadApi svIkAra na hogI| vAstava meM vahI pathabhraSTa haiM

nissaMdeha jina logoM ne inakAra kiyA aura inakAra hI kI dazA meM mare, to unameM kisI se dharatI ke barAbara sonA bhI, yadi usane prANa-mukti ke lie diyA ho, kadApi svIkAra nahIM kiyA jAegA| aise logoM ke lie dukhada yAtanA hai aura unakA koI sahAyaka na hogA

tuma nekI aura vafAdArI ke darje ko nahIM pahu~ca sakate, jaba taka ki una cIz2o ko (allAha ke mArga meM) qharca na karo, jo tumheM priya hai| aura jo cIz2a bhI tuma qharca karoge, nizcaya hI allAha ko usakA jJAna hogA

khAne kI sArI cIz2e isarAIla kI saMtAna ke lie halAla thI, sivAya una cIz2oM ke jinheM taurAta ke utarane se pahale isarAIla ne svayaM apane harAma kara liyA thA| kaho, 'yadi tuma sacce ho to taurAta lAo aura use par3ho|'
aba isake pazcAta bhI jo vyakti jhUThI bAteM allAha se jor3e, to aise hI loga atyAcArI hai
kaho, 'allAha ne saca kahA hai; ataH ibarAhIma ke tarIqe kA anusaraNa karo, jo hara ora se kaTakara eka kA ho gayA thA aura muzarikoM meM se na thA
'nisMsadeha ibAdata ke lie pahalA ghara jo 'mAnava ke lie' banAyA gayA vahIM hai jo makkA meM hai, barakatavAlA aura sarvathA mArgadarzana, saMsAravAloM ke lie

'usameM spaSTa nizAniyA~ hai, vaha ibarAhIma kA sthala hai| aura jisane usameM praveza kiyA, vaha nizcinta ho gayA| logoM para allAha kA haqa hai ki jisako vahA~ taka pahu~cane kI sAmarthya prApta ho, vaha isa ghara kA haja kare, aura jisane inakAra kiyA to (isa inakAra se allAha kA kucha nahIM bigar3atA) allAha to sAre saMsAra se nirapekSa hai|'
kaho, 'ai kitAbavAloM! tuma allAha kI AyatoM kA inakAra kyoM karate ho, jabaki jo kucha tuma kara rahe ho, allAha kI dRSTia meM hai?'

kaho, 'ai kitAbavAlo! tuma ImAna lAnevAloM ko allAha ke mArga se kyo rokate ho, tumheM usameM kisI Ter3ha kI talAza rahatI hai, jabaki tuma bhalI-bhA~ti vAstavikatA se avagata ho aura jo kucha tuma kara rahe ho, allAha usase beqhabara nahIM hai|'
ai ImAna lAnevAlo! yadi tumane unake kisI giroha kI bAta mAla lI, jinheM kitAba milI thI, to ve tumhAre ImAna lAne ke pazcAta phira tumheM adharmI banA deMge

aba tuma inakAra kaise kara sakate ho, jabaki tumheM allAha kI AyateM par3hakara sunAI jA rahI hai aura usakA rasUla tumhAre bIca maujUda hai? jo koI allAha ko maz2abUtI se pakar3a le, vaha sIdhe mArga para A gayA
ai ImAna lAnevAlo! allAha kA Dara rakho, jaisAki usakA Dara rakhane kA haqa hai| aura tumhArI mRtyu basa isa dazA meM Ae ki tuma muslima (AjJAkArI) ho

aura saba milakara allAha kI rassI ko maz2abUtI se pakar3a lo aura vibheda meM na par3o| aura allAha kI usa kRpA ko yAda karo jo tumapara huI| jaba tuma Apasa meM eka-dUsare ke zatru the to usane tumhAre diloM ko paraspara jor3a diyA aura tuma usakI kRpA se bhAI-bhAI bana gae| tuma Aga ke eka gaDDhe ke kinAre khar3e the, to allAha ne usase tumheM bacA liyA| isa prakAra allAha tumhAre lie apanI Ayate khola-kholakara bayAna karatA hai, tAki tuma mArga pA lo
aura tumheM eka aise samudAya kA rUpa dhAraNa kara lenA cAhie jo nekI kI ora bulAe aura bhalAI kA Adeza de aura burAI se roke| yahI saphalatA prApta karanevAle loga hai

tuma una logoM kI taraha na ho jAnA jo vibheda meM par3a gae, aura isake pazcAta ki unake pAsa khulI nizAniyA~ A cukI thI, ve vibheda meM par3a gae| ye vahI loga hai, jinake lie bar3I (ghora) yAtanA hai| (yaha yAtanA usa dina hogI)

jisa dina kitane hI cehare ujjvala hoMge aura kitane hI cehare kAle par3a jAe~ge, to jinake cehera kAle par3a gae hoMge (ve sadA yAtanA meM grasta raheMge| khulI nizAniyA~ Ane kA bAda jinhoMne vibheda kiyA) unase kahA jAegA, 'kyA tumane ImAna ke pazcAta inakAra kI nIti apanAI? to lo aba usa inakAra ke badale meM jo tuma karate rahe ho, yAtanA kA maz2A cakho|'
rahe ve loga jinake cehare ujjvala hoMge, ve allAha kI dayAlutA kI chAyA meM hoMge| ve usI meM sadaiva raheMge

phira kyA tumane usa vyakti ko dekhA jisane hamArI AyatoM kA inakAra kiyA aura kahA, 'mujhe to avazya hI dhana aura santAna milane ko hai?'
kyA usane parokSa ko jhA~kakara dekha liyA hai, yA rahamAna se koI vacana le rakhA hai?

kucha nahIM, ye unakI bandagI kA inakAra kareMge aura unake virodhI bana jAe~ge| -
kyA tumane dekhA nahIM ki hamane zaitAnoM ko chor3a rakhA hai, jo inakAra karanevAloM para niyukta hai?

yAda karo jisa dina hama Dara rakhanevAloM ke sammAnita giroha ke rUpa meM rahamAna ke pAsa ikaTThA kareMge|
aura aparAdhiyoM ko jahannama ke ghATa kI ora pyAsA hA~ka le jAe~ge|

isa bAta para ki unhoMne rahamAna ke lie beTA hone kA dAvA kiyA!

ataH hamane isa vANI ko tumhArI bhASA meM isI lie sahaja evaM upayukta banAyA hai, tAki tuma isake dvArA Dara rakhanevAloM ko zubha sUcanA do aura una jhagar3AlU logoM ko isake dvArA DarAo

hamane tumapara yaha quraAna isalie nahIM utArA ki tuma mazaqqata meM par3a jAo

vaha rahamAna hai, jo rAjAsana para virAjamAna huA
usI kA hai jo kucha AkAzoM meM hai aura jo kucha dharatI meM hai aura jo kucha ina donoM ke madhya hai aura jo kucha Ardra miTTI ke nIce hai
tuma cAhe bAta pukAra kara kaho (yA cupake se), vaha to chipI huI aura atyanta gupta bAta ko bhI jAnatA hai
allAha, ki usake sivA koI pUjya-prabhU nahIM| usake nAma bahuta hI acche haiM|

jabaki usane eka Aga dekhI to usane apane gharavAloM se kahA, 'Thaharo! maiMne eka Aga dekhI hai| zAyada ki tumhAre lie usameM se koI aMgArA le AU~ yA usa Aga para maiM mArga kA patA pA lU~|'
phira jaba vaha vahA~ pahu~cA to pukArA gayA, 'ai mUsA!
maiM hI terA raba hU~| apane jUte utAra de| tU pavitra ghATI 'tuvA' meM hai
maiMne tujhe cuna liyA hai| ataH suna, jo kucha prakAzanA kI jAtI hai
nissaMdeha maiM hI allAha hU~| mere sivA koI pUjya-prabhu nahIM| ataH tU merI bandagI kara aura merI yAda ke lie namAz2a qAyama kara
nizcaya hI vaha (qiyAmata kI) ghar3I AnevAlI hai - zIghra hI use lAU~gA, use chipAe rakhatA hU~ - tAki pratyeka vyakti jo prayAsa vaha karatA hai, usakA badalA pAe
ataH jo koI usapara ImAna nahIM lAtA aura apanI vAsanA ke pIche par3A hai, vaha tujhe usase roka na de, anyathA tU vinaSTa ho jAegA
aura ai mUsA! yaha tere dAhine hAtha meM kyA hai?'
usane kahA, 'yaha merI lAThI hai| maiM isapara Teka lagAtA hU~ aura isase apanI bakariyoM ke lie patte jhAr3atA hU~ aura isase merI dUsarI z2arUrateM bhI pUrI hotI hai|'
kahA, 'DAla de use, ai mUsA!'
ataH usane DAla diyA| sahasA kyA dekhate hai ki vaha eka sA~pa hai, jo daur3a rahA hai
kahA, 'ise pakar3a le aura Dara mata| hama ise isakI pahalI hAlata para lauTA deMge
aura apane hAtha apane bAz2U kI ora sameTa le| vaha binA kisI aiba ke rauzana dUsarI nizAnI ke rUpa meM nikalegA
isalie ki hama tujhe apanI bar3I nizAniyA~ dikhAe~
tU firaauna ke pAsa jA| vaha bahuta sarakaza ho gayA hai|'

hArUna ko, jo merA bhAI hai
usake dvArA merI kamara maz2abUta kara

ki hama adhika se adhika terI tasabIha kareM
aura tujhe qhUba yAda kareM
nizcaya hI tU hameM khUba dekha rahA hai|'
kahA, 'diyA gayA tujhe jo tUne mA~gA, ai mUsA!
hama to tujhapara eka bAra aura bhI upakAra kara cuke hai
jaba hamane terI mA~ ke dila meM yaha bAta DAlI thI, jo aba prakAzanA kI jA rahI hai,

ki usako sandUka meM rakha de; phira use dariyA meM DAla de; phira dariyA use taTa para DAla de ki use merA zatru aura usakA zatru uThA le| maiMne apanI ora se tujhapara apanA prema DAlA| (tAki tU surakSita rahe) aura tAki merI A~kha ke sAmane terA pAlana-poSaNa ho

jAo donoM, firaauna ke pAsa, vaha sarakaza ho gayA hai
usase narma bAta karanA, kadAcita vaha dhyAna de yA Dare|'

ataH jAo, usake pAsa aura kaho, hama tere raba ke rasUla hai| isarAIla kI santAna ko hamAre sAtha bheja de| aura unheM yAtanA na de| hama tere pAsa tere raba kI nizAnI lekara Ae hai| aura salAmatI hai usake lie jo saMmArga kA anusaraNa kare!
nissaMdeha hamArI ora prakAzanA huI hai ki yAtanA usake lie hai, jo jhuThalAe aura mu~ha phere|'
usane kahA, 'acchA, tuma donoM kA raba kauna hai, mUsA?'
kahA, 'hamArA raba vaha hai jisane hara cIz2a ko usakI AkRti dI, phira tadanukUva nirdezana kiyA|'
usane kahA, 'acchA to una nasloM kA kyA hAla hai, jo pahale thI?'
kahA, 'usakA jJAna mere raba ke pAsa eka kitAba meM surakSita hai| merA raba na cUkatA hai aura na bhUlatA hai|'
'vahI hai jisane tumhAre lie dharatI ko pAlanA (bichaunA) banAyA aura usane tumhAre lie rAste nikAle aura AkAza se pAnI utArA| phira hamane usake dvArA vibhinna prakAra ke per3a-paudhe nikAle
khAo aura apane caupAyoM ko bhI carAo! nissaMdeha isameM buddhimAnoM ke lie bahuta-sI nizAniyA~ hai
usI se hamane tumheM paidA kiyA aura usI meM hama tumheM lauTAte hai aura usI se tumheM dUsarI bAra nikAleMge|'
aura hamane firaauna ko apanI saba nizAniyA~ dikhAI, kintu usane jhuThalAyA aura inakAra kiyA|-
usane kahA, 'ai mUsA! kyA tU hamAre pAsa isalie AyA hai ki apane jAdU se hamako hamAre apane bhUbhAga se nikAla de?
acchA, hama bhI tere pAsa aisA hI jAdU lAte hai| aba hamAre aura apane bIca eka nizcita sthAna ThaharA le, koI bIca kI jagaha, na hama isake viruddha jAe~ aura na tU|'

ve Apasa meM cupake-cupake kaheMge ki 'tuma basa dasa hI dina Thahare ho|'
